fields.statement: QA at dfff1995 with a binary built from the branch (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza), in a scratch git repo with RHIZA_*/REX_* unset and a fake rex on PATH. Started a one-step wait workflow on a record change set, rewrote its journal's workflow to plan, ran rhiza land, then made the stop an interruption (dropped the stopped entry, appended a dead pid). rhiza daemon --permission-mode manual --once printed 'Resumed run <id>', journaled one daemon-resumed entry, and its real detached rhiza run resume --foreground process (no test hook) recorded its own process and ran the run to succeeded. Interrupted again (dead pid after daemon-resumed), a second daemon --once resumed nothing ('resumed': []) and daemon-resumed stayed at 1. A failed plan run on the landed record was not resumed. A ship-change run interrupted on a proposed, accepted and landed change set that never reached land, and a plan run interrupted on a withdrawn change set, were both left unresumed by daemon --once. Scoped tests: go test ./internal/daemon/... and the daemon-resume* testscripts pass.

QA at dfff1995 with a binary built from the branch, in the same scratch repo (fake rex, RHIZA_*/REX_* unset). An interrupted plan run on a landed record: rhiza inbox printed 'Nothing waits on you' (no skipped item). Interrupted again after the daemon's one resume: rhiza inbox listed 'gave-up run <id> ... interrupted again after the daemon's one resume, next: rhiza run resume <id>', and --json gave kind gave-up with that next. With the journal ending failed ('boom'): inbox listed 'failed run <id> ... next: rhiza run resume --retry <id>', and running that command really retried the step, after which the run succeeded. Negative cases: a ship-change run interrupted on a landed change set whose journal never reached land was listed 'skipped ... its change set is landed, next: rhiza run abandon <id>', and a plan run on a withdrawn change set 'skipped ... its change set is withdrawn, next: rhiza run abandon <id>'. Scoped tests: go test ./internal/api -run Inbox and the inbox*, unaccepted* and run-resume* testscripts pass.
